title: Best CNAPP Platforms for Every Business Size (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: For most mid-market and enterprise estates, Wiz (agentless correlation) and Microsoft Defender for Cloud (free tier → published plans) are the rational anchors; Orca matches agentless speed; Sysdig and Sweet Security add runtime depth; Prisma Cloud wins breadth; Rapid7 unifies with VM/SIEM programs; Data Theorem covers the API/app edge. The cloud-native application protection platform (CNAPP) has become the operating system of cloud security folding posture (CSPM), workload protection (CWPP), entitlements (CIEM), and increasingly data and runtime detection into one correlated view. The reason is arithmetic: separate tools produce thousands of disconnected findings, while CNAPPs surface the handful of toxic combinations that form real attack paths. But platform weight must match business size a 50-person startup and a multinational need very different CNAPPs. We scored eight platforms on five weighted criteria and detail each below features, ideal size, pros, cons. How we evaluate: editorial analysis of vendor documentation, public capability data, and market positioning not a paid placement, and no lab benchmark; validate with a proof of concept. Pricing by model only. Table of Contents 1. How We Evaluated 2. The Scorecard 3. The 8 Platforms in Depth 4. Full Comparison Table 5. Buyer’s Guide by Business Size 6. FAQ How We Evaluated Five weighted criteria: Correlation & prioritization (25%) attack paths over finding floods; Coverage breadth (25%) CSPM+CWPP+CIEM+d
